## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 64 captures during January 2019. This provides the activity total for the month and establishes the volume considered in the image-quality and grading review. The recorded captures are reported for the site as a whole, with no further breakdown provided in this report.

## Image quality

Image quality was assessed for the captures completed during the reporting period. Of the recorded images, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.7 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the results that received a grading outcome.

## Grading

The grading results included 8 referable findings. The median lag between capture and grading was 9 days. This measure summarises the central turnaround time for the grading activity recorded during January 2019.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.
